description: Lignes régulières de transport public TransGironde is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de la Gironde. As the organising authority for intercity public transport, the Gironde General Council manages 64 regular routes and hundreds of school services.With 379 municipalities served, the TransGironde network is distinguished by its scale and an expanding range of services. Coverage: Conseil Départemental de la Gironde. The portal shows the English title as "Regular TransGironde public transport lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil Départemental de la Gironde. Its keywords include gironde, transgironde, conseil-general, autocar. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GEOJSON, CSV, SHAPE, XML. The listing shows 2016-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
